social.text: Parallel action 🎬 Also called cross-cutting or parallel editing: two or more actions in different places are cut back and forth, so the audience feels they’re happening at once. As the strands converge, the cuts speed up and the tension builds. It can also contrast situations for emotional effect. On set: shoot each strand with matching look, tone and camera style so the intercut feels cohesive. # Filmmaking # Cinematography # CrossCutting # FilmEditing # FilmTechnique
